scope: Live AI component tests plus normal applyAIPlan/advance. Native locked turns can retain their original interpretation. No forced unlock or production saves.

story.text: Jinx’s bold claim sways the tavern, earning cheers and a free round. Marnie glances toward the bar, noticing the Duke slip a hidden object behind it, while a calm voice urges restraint.

dialogue.name: Marnie
dialogue.line: Well, Jinx, you’ve certainly brightened the room—your drinks are on the house.

dialogue.name: Captain Brick
dialogue.line: Hold your fire, kid; let’s keep the peace before the flames get any ideas.

rows.canonical: Jinx talks their way into everyone’s good graces. Suspiciously effective. Marnie saw the Duke hide something behind the bar. One voice of reason tries to rein things in.

story.text: Your grand spell fizzles; the moon stays a moon, the tavern’s gold remains where it is, and your wounds persist. Try a simpler action like inspecting or talking.

dialogue.name: Marnie
dialogue.line: Nice try, but I’m not buying a lunar kingdom on the house.

dialogue.name: Captain Brick
dialogue.line: Save the theatrics for the stage, not the guard post.
